sections.content: How many people are "IT quality and testing professionals"?

17,505 people

were counted on the census as "IT quality and testing professionals" in England and Wales in March 2021.
IT quality and testing professionals test the quality of IT software, systems and computer games and identify and recommend solutions to problems and improvements that could be made.

How old are people who do this job?

The largest age group of people who had this job were those aged 30 to 34 years. Of the whole working population 12% were aged 30 to 34 years. For people working as "IT quality and testing professionals", 19.7% were in this age group.

The age group with the smallest proportion of people working as "IT quality and testing professionals" was 16 to 19 years.

sections.content:
Other jobs that had a similar age profile to "IT quality and testing professionals" included:

  • natural and social science professionals (other)
  • physiotherapists
  • marketing and commercial managers

Select your age group to see the ten most popular occupations for your age

More men than women had this job

Among people working as "IT quality and testing professionals" there were more men than women (64.4% compared with 35.6%).

This means "IT quality and testing professionals" had a different proportion of men and women compared with the wider occupation group it falls within of "science, research, engineering and technology professionals".

Men made up 64.4% and women made up 35.6% of "IT quality and testing professionals"
Across the whole working population, 52% were men and 48% were women.

Other jobs that had a similar proportion of men and women to "IT quality and testing professionals" included:

  • prison service officers (below principal officer)
  • chartered architectural technologists, planning officers and consultants
  • web design professionals

These are the occupations for which the proportion of men and women was most equally split:

  • quality assurance and regulatory professionals
  • chartered and certified accountants
  • conservation professionals

We can look at who worked as "IT quality and testing professionals" by age group and for men and women at the same time to see how these two factors interact.

Men and women with this occupation had a similar age profile, as shown in the chart below.

The percentage of men and women who are "IT quality and testing professionals" across age groups

How many people do this job by disability status, employment type and area

Of people working as "IT quality and testing professionals", 7.6% were disabled. This means people said they had a long-term condition that limited them "a little" or "a lot" in their day-to-day activities. The average for all occupations is 9.6%.

Disability is more common among people who are older. This occupation had more people aged between 30 and 49 years compared with the whole working population.

People with this job were more likely to work full-time than part-time (92.5% compared with 7.5%).

They are also more likely to be an employee (94.1%) than self-employed (5.9%).

The region of England and Wales with the highest percentage of people with this job was the South East. At a local level, the areas with the highest percentage of people in this occupation included Leeds, this is in the region of the Yorkshire & Humberside.
